important_interpretation: Evidence supports event awareness only if both co-primary endpoints show positive differences and Holm-adjusted p < .05. The experiment does not guarantee this outcome.

primary_conclusion.event_aware_vs_schema_only: Event-aware tabular differential Q-learning had higher held-out reward rate and survival in the matched timed-refuge ecology; both co-primary differences were positive and Holm-adjusted p < .05.
primary_conclusion.interpretation_scope: This supports event-awareness in the frozen synthetic timed-refuge ecology. Survival advantages do not consistently generalize to the high-noise and wide-warning stress conditions.

paper_inspired_patch_baseline.description: Separate discretized three-patch average-reward policy-iteration calibration inspired by Zeraati et al. (CCN 2025); not an exact replication and not directly comparable to the main task.
